rationale: Moe is building developer tools and LLM tooling at Flowzy, while Yuzhen is scaling AI-powered automation for business operations at DaBoss.ai—complementary focuses within the AI space. intro_message: Moe, meet Yuzhen Zhu — she's building AI automation tools for business at DaBoss.ai and your LLM tooling expertise at Flowzy could be a natural fit to explore together.
